title: We Work Here Now
description: While Kid-2 and Kid-3 help Grandma feed the fish at the top of a giant aquarium, Kid-2 decides their exciting new responsibility must mean they work there now.
alt: Kid-2 and Kid-3 stand with Grandma Kelly on the rocky upper ledge of a giant indoor fish tank, dropping food to the fish gathering below. Kid-2 grins and says, 'I think this means we work here now,' while Kid-3 excitedly replies, 'Best day ever.' Down beside the viewing glass, Pa takes pictures with his phone while Kid-1 holds a bright blue Dunkin drink and watches the feeding fish with a grossed-out expression.
